items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: And that fella that came to teach me, Paul Rosi had a band in Baudis Elmo.

ctx.x: And who played in the band there?

Well now Mike Taylor had the band in the Bui. The name was Spencer Taylor but everybody called him Mike. And I can't think of all the fellas, they were the Sawmill guys, they called it Sawmill. Yeah. They didn't play until on Sundays you know. Couldn't play no other day. And that fella that came to teach me, Paul Rosi had a band in Baudis Elmo. And a fella named Tooker, I forget, Tooker, real name, but he had the band that raised it, the old men bands. And Johnny Hills, he was the boy that took over the young…
